title: Historical Earthquake Database of the Dead Sea Transform Region
description: This repository provides a harmonized geospatial database of historical earthquakes affecting the Dead Sea Transform and adjacent regions. The database integrates historical documentary evidence, archaeological observations, environmental earthquake effects, and geographic information into a standardized relational structure suitable for historical seismology, archaeoseismology, Historical GIS, and interdisciplinary geoscientific research. The release includes historical earthquake catalogues, earthquake damage observations, environmental effects, a historical and archaeological site gazetteer, and a statistical analysis notebook. The project is openly available through GitHub and permanently archived in Zenodo to support reproducibility, versioning, and persistent citation.
